components.description: Categorical comparisons — use when comparing values across discrete groups (regions, products, channels)
Time series trends — use when data has a time/date dimension and shows change over time
Tabular data — use for large multi-column datasets, drill-down views, or when exact values matter
Single metric highlight — use for headline numbers, totals, or key performance indicators
Multiple KPI cards in a grid — use when showing 2-6 headline metrics together
AI-enhanced table with smart formatting, sorting, and column inference — prefer over Table for richer display
Compact embedded chart — use inside cards or panels where space is limited
Full report visualization layout — use when rendering a multi-section analytical report with charts and tables
Preview of a report layout with drag-and-drop support — use when showing report structure to the user
Loading placeholder — use while data or LLM response is streaming in
Full BigQuery data dashboard — use when user asks for live data, real metrics, or dashboard views connected to BigQuery
Top-level report shell wrapping summary, analysis, and details sections — automatically composed by pipeline
